measurement_limits: Session evidence is limited to the selected bounded event page and recorded provider artifacts.
Host resource samples describe host state at capture time; they are not agent-attributed consumption and do not establish pressure or causation.
Unavailable historical context remains unavailable; current session context is not retroactive attribution.

context.work_intent_goal: Validate published capture and authoritative request-to-result observation for this development task

decision_opportunities.scope: Environment-bound capability requests in selected event window; not every agent decision

measurement_limits: Capability interactions cover Environment-bound invocations; direct external tools are outside this session event view.
Control read-operation events contain bounded operation and outcome fields, never raw arguments or responses.
Control read-operation repository branch/head fields come from the authenticated session-selected checkout; this projection does not re-probe Git at each operation.
Model identity, token usage, execution duration, and resource consumption are not inferred when the runtime does not expose them.
The Store page reader verifies only selected event payloads; finding their bindings still scans the generation's metadata index.
Resource samples are bounded aggregate host snapshots linked to Environment invocations; they do not measure agent-attributed consumption or establish pressure by themselves.

Repository ref transitions are Environment observations. An exact preflight match establishes a later observation of the same checkout preimage, not that the eligible operation caused the change or that a remote publication succeeded.

Coordination-deferred records describe operations withheld for a scope or concurrency condition; they are not authority denials or owner-approval requests, and do not prove the proposed work was invalid.

Claim-coordination activity records bounded claim-state transitions, not exclusive work authority, accepted modifications, or development outcomes. Historical events without objective references remain unlinked.
Repository ref transition correlation uses only exact checkout identity and head preimages in the selected session event window; an absent match may be outside the bounded window.

Claim lifecycle correlations match exact repository, owner-session, and claim identities across bounded event pages; shared identity does not establish that a transition caused a denial, deferral, or later preflight.
